method.identity: Exact accepted V48 project ID; DLD subject series has identityVerified=true
method.coordinate: Recorded PSR project coordinate only; approximate community centres excluded
method.qualification: Official DLD subject median with at least 20 eligible sales and positive AED/sqft value
method.deduplication: Only native Flat and Villa subtype series; overlapping parent Residential Unit/Villa and shared area-context series excluded
method.time: Native monthly or quarterly period end; source snapshot is retrospective latest vintage
method.interpretation: Supplemental project observations, not additive to area sales counts or the area median raster
